title: [LOGGED IN] Login with the user-id link shows the player and both balances

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store?user-id={TEST_USER_ID} in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Store page loaded and logged in (offers skeleton first, then content).

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss". If a "Login successful" popup is shown, click "Ok".
steps.saw: Cookie banner was shown, clicked Dismiss. No visible 'Login successful' popup in the screenshot, so Ok was not clicked.

steps.text: Does the header show the green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button, and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Green 'Player{TEST_USER_ID}' button at the top right; no visible Login button (0 found).

steps.text: Does the header show a gold store points balance and a teal loyalty points balance next to the "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button?
steps.saw: Header shows a gold-icon balance '0' and a teal-icon balance '40' just left of the Player{TEST_USER_ID} button.
Header shows Home, Store, Reward chain, Loyalty shop.
